adjudication.rationale: In `db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb`, `category_id` is computed via `execute(...)[0]['id'].to_i`. If the query returns zero rows (e.g., no `site_settings` row for `embed_category` or it doesn’t match any category name), `execute(...)[0]` is `nil`, so `nil['id']` raises `NoMethodError` before the `if category_id == 0` fallback can run. Even when it doesn’t crash, a matched row’s `id` can’t realistically be `0` for an ActiveRecord category, so the `== 0` branch is effectively unreachable. The same unguarded `[0]['value']` pattern also appears in the fallback query (`uncategorized_category_id`) and would similarly crash if that setting row were missing.
